run `python3 checks/parity/par-macshell.py` (J0.17 copies its shots into the check's results folder, no KEEP_RUN_DIR) and read _captures/results/par-macshell/pics/r9-foot-list-1280-light.png, r9-foot-list-1280-dark.png, r9-foot-reader-1280-light.png, r9-foot-reader-1280-dark.png, r9-foot-composer-1280-light.png, r9-foot-composer-1280-dark.png (or $WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR/pics/)
